request.subject: PORTRAIT:MARTIAN:GUARD

layers.text: Make the dish he holds much bigger: the top half of one big round polished chrome energy shield disc fills the bottom of the image in front of his chest, wider than his shoulders, with a glowing hot magenta lens at its centre and a thin hot magenta rim. Keep his lavender head, big black eyes above the shield, glass bubble helmet, antenna, big round shoulder plates, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
